facts.text: I inherited my grandmother's vintage diamond necklace recently.
I inherited an antique music box from my great-aunt recently.
I inherited a set of depression-era glassware from my mom recently.
I want to insure my grandmother's vintage diamond necklace.
I want to insure the antique music box from my great-aunt.
I want to insure the depression-era glassware from my mom.
I want to know what documentation I need to provide for the appraisal process of my grandmother's vintage diamond necklace.
I want to know what factors will affect the appraisal value of my grandmother's vintage diamond necklace.
I plan to get the necklace appraised and insured first.
I plan to move on to appraising and insuring the music box and glassware after the necklace.
I plan to search online for appraisers in my area certified by organizations like NAJA or ASA.
I plan to ask my friends and family if they know reputable appraisers they've worked with.
I think I will start with one appraisal report for each item.
I think I will get multiple appraisals only if I need to later.

events.text: User plans to start by getting the necklace appraised and insured, then appraise and insure the music box and glassware.
User plans to search online for appraisers in their area certified by NAJA or ASA and ask friends/family for recommendations.
User plans to start with one appraisal report for each item and get multiple appraisals only if needed later.
